name: Giuseppe Giannetta

events.title: Marriage to Vinchinza (Vincenza) Gillette
events.place: St. Rocco's Catholic Church, Dunmore, PA
events.description: License No. 753 sworn 27 May 1933; Joseph 20, laborer, b. Dunmore, 133 Sand St; bride 20, silk hand, b. Dunmore, 135 Sand St (next door), daughter of the late Gaetano Gillette and Angeline Savino; married by Rev. Michele De Larno.

bioAdditions: Joseph married the girl next door: Vinchinza (Vincenza) Gillette of 135 Sand Street, a silk-mill hand. They married at St. Rocco's Catholic Church, Dunmore, on 17 June 1933 (S1). The Gillette family had lived beside the Giannettas since at least 1910, when Tony Gillette's household is enumerated immediately before Francesco 'Janet''s on Sand Street (S2).
